# SAGEDO — India's First AI + Human Hybrid Execution Team
> India's First Sovereign Revenue & AI Execution Partner
> Speed of AI. Precision of Humans.
> Production digital infrastructure, custom CRMs, web apps, and automated workflows delivered with aerospace engineering rigor.

SAGEDO (https://sagedo.in) bridges the execution gap for Indian SMBs, high-growth startups, and sovereign enterprises. We combine rapid AI-native workflows with rigorous human engineering verification to build conversion-engineered websites, custom CRMs without recurring per-seat software taxes, automated WhatsApp sales gateways, and ERP-integrated enterprise systems.

## Core Guarantees & Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- **48-Hour Functional Prototype Guarantee**: Every engagement receives an interactive, functional prototype within 48 hours of onboarding. Clients verify live UI/UX and workflows before full production deployment.
- **Phased Milestone Production Timelines**:
  - Starter Launch & Digital Presence: 7–14 calendar days to production launch.
  - Sovereign Revenue Engine™: 28 calendar days with 10-gate QA certification.
  - Enterprise Infrastructure: 45–60 calendar days with custom milestone stages.
- **30-Point Human Engineering Verification Warranty**: Zero raw, unvetted AI code is delivered to production. Every deliverable undergoes a proprietary 30-point aerospace-grade engineering verification audit covering mobile viewport responsiveness (down to 360px), zero client-side price tampering vulnerabilities, strict MIME/file upload validation, cross-browser performance (sub-1.2s LCP), and security hardening. Backed by a 7-day post-handover warranty for zero-cost defect resolution.
- **Milestone-Gated 90% Money-Back Guarantee**: All engagements operate on transparent, milestone-gated deliverables. If SAGE DO fails to deliver an agreed milestone or verifiable specifications cannot be satisfied following revision sprints, the client receives a 90% refund of the milestone fee (the remaining 10% strictly covers hard non-recoverable third-party infrastructure and cloud provisioning costs).

## Track 1: SMB LaunchPad (One-Time Builds)
Bespoke digital foundation packages engineered for Indian SMBs, local businesses, and modern founders seeking fast go-to-market with zero recurring agency bloat.

- **Starter Launch — ₹15,000 (SKU-SMB-15K)**:
  - Deliverables: 5-page high-converting mobile web storefront (sub-1.2s LCP), complete logo & brand identity kit, Google Business Profile setup + local 3-pack SEO basics, professional business email & domain configuration, direct WhatsApp speed-to-lead routing webhook.
  - Delivery: 48-Hour Functional Prototype Guarantee | 7 calendar days to production launch.

- **Full Launch — ₹35,000 (SKU-SMB-35K) [Most Popular for SMBs]**:
  - Deliverables: 10+ page conversion-engineered architecture with blog, custom lightweight CRM with automated WhatsApp sales bot, Google Business Profile with full local AEO/GEO optimization, social media setup with 30-day launch content assets, dynamic quote calculator, and automated lead alerts.
  - Delivery: 48-Hour Functional Prototype Guarantee | 10–12 calendar days to production launch.

- **VIP / Scale Launch — ₹95,000 (SKU-SMB-95K)**:
  - Deliverables: Cross-platform native mobile application (Android/iOS) + web app, unlimited seats custom CRM pipeline, multi-agent autonomous operational workflows, dedicated growth engineer during launch, and custom admin dashboard with real-time sales and lead analytics.
  - Delivery: 48-Hour Functional Prototype Guarantee | 15 calendar days to production launch.

## Track 2: Enterprise Sovereign Suites (Sovereign Infrastructure)
Bespoke enterprise-grade systems designed to eliminate recurring per-seat SaaS taxes, provide full source code sovereignty, and bridge legacy operations into autonomous digital pipelines.

- **Digital Presence Engine — ₹45,000 (SKU-ENT-45K)**:
  - Scope: Inbound lead capture & sovereign WhatsApp gateway.
  - Deliverables: Custom mobile web storefront (sub-1.2s LCP), WhatsApp Cloud API qualification webhook, interactive dynamic revenue calculator/quoter, automated founder WhatsApp alerts, SSL + edge CDN acceleration setup.
  - Pricing & Terms: ₹45,000 (available in 3 milestone installments from ₹15,000/mo). Optional Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC): ₹15,000/mo.
  - Delivery: 48-Hour Functional Prototype Guarantee | 14 calendar days to production launch.

- **Sovereign Revenue Engine™ — ₹1,50,000 (SKU-ENT-150K) [Flagship Enterprise Tier]**:
  - Scope: Custom CRM & zero-seat software tax infrastructure.
  - Deliverables: Full custom CRM architecture (zero per-seat fees, unlimited seats, zero vendor lock-in), automated WhatsApp lead routing & counselor tracking, native Tally Prime / ERP bridge integration, real-time margin & sales velocity dashboard, and complete source code and database ownership handover.
  - Pricing & Terms: ₹1,50,000 (available in 3 milestone installments from ₹50,000/mo). Optional Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC): ₹25,000/mo.
  - Delivery: 48-Hour Functional Prototype Guarantee | 28 calendar days (10-gate QA certified).

- **Enterprise Infrastructure — Starting at ₹3,50,000 (SKU-ENT-350K)**:
  - Scope: Sovereign enterprise automation & ERP bridge.
  - Deliverables: Deep bi-directional Tally Prime & accounting ledger sync, multi-branch dispatch & quotation workflows, custom AI OCR document processing pipeline, sovereign VPS deployment (zero data retention by third parties), and priority 2-hour P1 dedicated server SLA.
  - Pricing & Terms: Starting at ₹3,50,000 (custom milestone installment schedule). Optional Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC): ₹35,000/mo.
  - Delivery: 48-Hour Functional Prototype Guarantee | 45–60 calendar days to production deployment.
